title: Venezuelan Farfalle Pasta Bake
description: A rich and creamy baked pasta dish with venezuelan cheese and aerated texture, inspired by venezuelan cuisine.
instructions: Cook the farfalle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, combine the tomato sauce and 20ml of vegetable oil. Heat over medium heat.
Add the grated rich cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, the cheese sauce, and the shredded aerated cheese. Mix well.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional grated rich cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
